source.source_sufficiency_method: manual source-first review of the authoritative policy wording; atomic boundaries follow source-expressed normative propositions, not target ontology structure

atomic_units.source_support_summary: PED and direct complications are excluded for a continuous-coverage period from first My Health Care Plan inception; the opted period is stated in the Policy Schedule.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: PED waiting period is a policy-wide base exclusion measured from first My Health Care Plan inception with a Policy-Schedule-selected duration.

atomic_units.source_support_summary: Plan 1 records PED 36 months and the table lists change options of 1, 2 and 3 years.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: PED duration has a governed selectable domain of 1, 2 or 3 years, with Plan 1 showing 36 months.

atomic_units.source_support_summary: The PED exclusion applies afresh to the increased Sum Insured extent.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: PED waiting period reapplies only to the increased Sum Insured portion after enhancement.

atomic_units.source_support_summary: Continuous portability coverage reduces the PED waiting period to the extent of prior coverage.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Eligible portability continuity can reduce the PED waiting period by prior continuous coverage credit.

atomic_units.source_support_summary: Post-wait PED coverage requires declaration at application and insurer acceptance.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: PED coverage after expiry of the selected wait remains conditional on declaration and acceptance.

atomic_units.source_support_summary: Listed conditions are excluded for a selected continuous-coverage period, with accident claims excluded from this waiting-period exclusion.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Specified disease/procedure wait is a base exclusion from first-plan inception and does not apply to accident claims.

atomic_units.source_support_summary: Plan 1 records 24 months and the specific-disease waiting-period change options are 1, 2 and 3 years.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Specified disease/procedure duration has a selectable domain of 1, 2 or 3 years, with Plan 1 showing 24 months.

atomic_units.source_support_summary: The specified-disease exclusion applies afresh to the increased Sum Insured extent.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Specified disease/procedure waiting period reapplies to the increased Sum Insured portion.

atomic_units.source_support_summary: When a listed condition also falls under PED, the longer of the two waits applies.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Effective wait for a specified condition that is also PED is the longer of the PED and specified-disease waits.

atomic_units.source_support_summary: The listed-condition waiting period applies even when contracted after risk inception or declared and accepted without a specific exclusion.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Specified disease/procedure wait can apply to listed conditions arising after risk inception or accepted without a specific exclusion.

atomic_units.source_support_summary: Applicable portability continuity reduces the specified-disease wait to the extent of prior coverage.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Eligible portability continuity can reduce the specified-disease/procedure wait by prior coverage credit.

atomic_units.source_locator: page 21 clause 3 and page 53 waiting-period table
atomic_units.source_support_summary: Illness treatment is excluded for the initial selected period from first policy commencement, except accident; Plan 1 records 30 days.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Initial illness waiting period is 30 days for Plan 1 from first commencement, subject to the stated accident exception.

atomic_units.source_locator: page 15, Doctor Prescribed Lab and Radiology Cover exclusion 4
atomic_units.source_support_summary: Investigation cover has an illness-related 30-day wait in the first policy year and the wait does not apply on renewals.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Doctor Prescribed Lab and Radiology Cover has its own benefit-scoped 30-day illness wait in year one, ceasing on renewal.

atomic_units.source_locator: page 15, Doctor Prescribed Lab and Radiology Cover exclusion 5(a-b)
atomic_units.source_support_summary: The investigation benefit independently applies the PED exclusion and takes the opted PED period from the Policy Schedule.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Doctor Prescribed Lab and Radiology Cover is subject to a benefit-scoped PED wait using the Policy-Schedule-selected PED duration.

atomic_units.source_locator: page 15, Doctor Prescribed Lab and Radiology Cover exclusion 5(c)
atomic_units.source_support_summary: Portability continuity reduces this benefit-scoped PED wait to the extent of prior coverage.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Eligible portability credit applies to the investigation benefit's PED waiting period.

atomic_units.source_locator: page 15, Doctor Prescribed Lab and Radiology Cover exclusion 5(d)
atomic_units.source_support_summary: Post-wait PED coverage under the investigation benefit remains subject to declaration and acceptance.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Investigation-cover PED coverage after expiry of the wait requires declaration and insurer acceptance.

atomic_units.source_locator: page 21 Maternity Package Waiting Period and page 53 table
atomic_units.source_support_summary: Maternity has a continuous-coverage waiting period selected in the Policy Schedule; Plan 1 records 36 months.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Maternity has a distinct schedule-selected waiting period, with Plan 1 showing 36 months.

atomic_units.source_locator: page 21 Maternity Package Waiting Period and page 53 table
atomic_units.source_support_summary: The maternity wait decreases by one year when a long-term policy is chosen and the entire premium is paid upfront.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Long-term-policy upfront premium payment conditionally reduces maternity waiting period by one year.

atomic_units.source_locator: page 21 Baby Care Waiting Period and page 53 table
atomic_units.source_support_summary: Baby Care has a continuous-coverage waiting period selected in the Policy Schedule; Plan 1 records 36 months.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Baby Care has a distinct schedule-selected waiting period, with Plan 1 showing 36 months.

atomic_units.source_locator: page 21 Baby Care Waiting Period and page 53 table
atomic_units.source_support_summary: The Baby Care wait decreases by one year when a long-term policy is chosen and the entire premium is paid upfront.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Long-term-policy upfront premium payment conditionally reduces Baby Care waiting period by one year.

atomic_units.source_support_summary: Eligible portability carries accrued continuity benefits in waiting periods under applicable IRDAI portability guidelines.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Portability is a recognized continuity mechanism for waiting-period credit where continuity requirements are met.

atomic_units.source_support_summary: Eligible migration within the insurer carries accrued waiting-period continuity benefits subject to IRDAI migration guidelines.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Migration is a recognized continuity mechanism, while exact effective credit remains dependent on applicable regulatory guidance.
atomic_units.governance_note: BENEFIT_ESTABLISHING regulatory effect; effective credit remains unquantified pending regulatory verification

atomic_units.source_support_summary: On withdrawal, migration to a similar insurer product at renewal preserves accrued continuity benefits including waiting-period waiver subject to IRDAI guidelines and no break.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Product withdrawal can trigger migration with continuity of waiting-period benefits when the policy has no break, subject to regulatory guidance.
atomic_units.governance_note: BENEFIT_ESTABLISHING regulatory effect; effective credit remains unquantified pending regulatory verification

atomic_units.source_locator: page 30 Change of Sum Insured clause 21 and page 38 Sum Insured Enhancement clause 35(iii)
atomic_units.source_support_summary: For increased Sum Insured, waits restart only for the enhanced portion from the enhancement effective date as fresh exposure.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Sum Insured enhancement creates a distinct enhanced-amount tranche whose applicable waiting periods restart from the enhancement effective date.

atomic_units.source_locator: page 38 Inclusion of members under the Policy clause 36
atomic_units.source_support_summary: A member added by endorsement or renewal is treated as being in the first policy year for PED, exclusions and waits.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Newly added insured beneficiaries start applicable waiting-period exposure from their addition policy year, whether added by endorsement or renewal.

atomic_units.source_support_summary: Cataract surgery payment is conditional on expiry of the Policy-Schedule waiting period; separate payment limits vary by SI band.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Cataract payment depends on expiry of a Policy-Schedule-specified waiting period, while SI-band cost sharing remains a separate mechanic.

atomic_units.source_support_summary: Standard exclusions and waiting periods apply to day-care procedures according to the medical condition or disease treated.
atomic_units.normative_proposition: Day-care procedures inherit applicable standard waiting periods based on the underlying disease or condition.

review_decision.notes: The original 13 records remain clause groups. Atomic units are source-expression-based and source-sufficiency reviewed. Repeated source-specific PED/specific clauses are retained where independently stated; the generic SI-enhancement clause remains one broad unit rather than ontology-driven duplication.
